correctness.rationale: Derive all barycentric moments explicitly from Dirichlet(1,1,1), then extract all even-order coefficients of 1/[1-(s2/2)t^2-(s3/3)t^3]. Delta=s2^3/2-3s3^2 proves eta in [0,1] and exact equality classes. Positivity of the j=1 coefficient proves sharp strict directionality for every m>=3. Beta(1,2) integration gives the exact upper constant. A two-antiderivative divided difference for |t|^3 yields the cubic formula, and the positive-factor derivative establishes strict reversal. Exact SymPy checker verifies finite symbolic identities and endpoint values, but all-order proof is analytic.
